item.title: Power Issue - LON2 [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Our team will keep the communication for the affected customers via ongoing tickets.

item.title: Network Connectivity Issues - New York [resolved]
item.description: We experienced an issue on one of our border routers in New York. The router did not fail completely, however some services were impacted, which required a reboot to fully restore normal operation. During this time, our redundant infrastructure ensured that only part of the traffic was affected. Traffic is now fully stable, we are monitoring the health status closely and will share a full update once our investigation is complete.

item.description:
Between 14:00 BRT and 14:10 BRT (17:00 UTC — 17:10 UTC) on May 22, 2026, a subset of customers experienced intermittent 5xx errors on the Dashboard and API.
The issue was identified, mitigated, and services are fully operational.
We apologize for the inconvenience. If you continue to experience issues, please reach out to our support team.
